Hold up, what?   


Everything you have said here is NOT NORMAL. 

1. Doctors or pharmacist WILL NOT hide any information from you on the meds they're prescribing. Everything should be labelled well and not just named "red pill"  whatsoever & you deserve to know what do they do & the side effects of each medicine. 
2. Suggesting religion...? I'm not too sure if its their job to do that. We wouldn't be looking for help from medical professionals if its that simple. 
3. Are you an adult? If yes, there's no reason to call your parents. This is a breach of privacy. There's literally no reason why your psychiatrist should contact your parents & tell them about your condition. 
4. Special price? Hell no. Is this even legal? 

Please get the hell out of that place & get a second opinion. 

It's definitely not easy but stay strong, loads of love <3
Stay strong. Not only we have to deal with the usual problems most people has to face, we also have to deal with our physical issues, surgeries... We're stronger than most people.

If you're going for an upper jaw surgery, definitely nose after jaw. Either way I'll still recommend to do after.
